digest.component_or_area: clarity scoring and acceptance criteria detection
propositions: Two regexes and one scope extractor key on `## Success Criteria` heading; they must be repointed to `## Acceptance Criteria` to verify store migration and collapse the AC/SC vocabulary.

The epic branch of `_clarity_score` in gates.py and its lockstep copy in det_floor.py must repoint the +2 bonus from `^##\s+Success Criteria` to `^##\s+Acceptance Criteria` while preserving the score of 6 for the test fixture.
The `_SCOPE_HEADINGS` list in assemble.py must drop the `"## success criteria"` entry since AC is the canonical heading.
Seven test fixture files must be migrated: those with both headings drop the SC block; those with only SC must rename it to `## Acceptance Criteria` and convert bullets to `- [ ]` items.

A new contract test must assert an epic carrying `## Acceptance Criteria` and `## Context` passes both clarity-check and check-ac, with `_clarity_score(fixture, "epic") == 6` proving the repoint is score-neutral.

All occurrences of `## Success Criteria` must be removed from production code and live test fixtures, verified by grep returning no matches in the named paths (excluding the new negative-case contract test).
